title: Recurring employee availability
description: Define weekly availability across all sites, effective from explicit dates. Only covered times can be scheduled within a configured period. Without a policy, existing scheduling rules apply. This does not change attendance, wages or leave entitlements.
forbidden: Only managers and administrators can manage employee availability.
datesNotice: Dates use the business timezone. The end date is not included. A change must start strictly inside the previous period and preserves its timezone and end date.
createNotice: Saving applies this restriction across every site. Existing shifts outside these windows must be resolved first; none will be cancelled automatically.
replaceNotice: The previous policy remains in effect before the selected date. A linked successor applies afterward, with the same timezone and original end date. Existing shifts will not be cancelled.
voidNotice: Voiding removes this policy’s scheduling restriction for its entire period. It does not cancel shifts or remove attendance or decision history.
nextDay: Ends on the following day (up to 24 hours)
windowsNotice: Windows must not overlap. Overnight windows are split at midnight. Maximum 56 day segments after splitting; 00:00 to 00:00 with “following day” means a full day.
emptyWeek: No available time in this weekly policy.
emptyAcknowledgement: I confirm that this employee will be unavailable all week throughout this period, at every site.
invalidWindows: Enter valid windows of up to 24 hours without overlaps. Use the following-day option for overnight windows. Maximum 56 day segments.
invalidDates: Choose valid dates. The end must follow the start; a change must start strictly inside the previous policy’s period.
reasonLength: Enter a reason between 10 and 500 characters.
privacyNotice: Keep only the operational explanation needed for this decision. Do not include diagnoses or sensitive personal details.
saveError: The availability decision could not be saved. Review it and try again.
empty: No availability policies match these filters.
successor: Effective successor to a previous policy.
historyNotice: Each decision preserves its original weekly windows, effective period and explanation. Replacement and voiding do not erase previous evidence.
